cards.lore: The crown takes the field. The field remembers.
cards.power: You read the eviction notice. You feel a small fire start in your chest.

cards.lore: Every revolt starts with a tool that was always a weapon.
cards.power: You take what was once a farming tool and use it for something else.

cards.lore: They paved a holiness over and called it progress.
cards.power: You set fire to what they built on your field.

cards.lore: A man with a field becomes a man with a mob, and neither one was the goal.
cards.power: You cause a revolt. Chant a rebel rant; move the Quest Die ±2.

cards.lore: A blade for hire is honest in a way that a blade for principle is not.
cards.power: You take the next contract. You don't read the small print.

cards.lore: A reputation pays better than a sword and shows up faster.
cards.power: You raise your rates. The contracts come faster.

cards.lore: Loyalty is for the man who can afford it.
cards.power: You take contracts from all four spheres at once. Nobody knows.

cards.lore: To win every job is to lose every name that called you something else.
cards.power: You read the contract. The contract is the only thing that talks back.

cards.lore: A first device that works is a promise the workshop has not yet broken.
cards.power: You build the small device. The small device works.

cards.lore: Scale is the workshop's enemy and its only honest tutor.
cards.power: You build a bigger device. The bigger device explodes.

cards.lore: A machine that explains itself by exploding has explained more than most teachers.
cards.power: You build the device that explains itself.

cards.lore: The body that survived its own invention has no use for warnings anymore.
cards.power: You are the explosion. The party loves you and fears you.

cards.lore: A path is a story. The hunter is its first reader.
cards.power: You see the trail others walked past.

cards.lore: Patience is a kind of speed nobody has yet measured.
cards.power: You wait. The shot finds itself.

cards.lore: A trail you find is a question. The asking is sometimes the whole answer.
cards.power: You track the one who asked not to be tracked.

cards.cardName: Lvl 4: The One Who Shot the Deer
cards.lore: A perfect shot is a question with no place left to land.
cards.power: You find what you hunted. You find what you hunted for.

cards.lore: Strength remembered loud is strength remembered last.
cards.power: You win the bar-fight. They put your name on a chalkboard.

cards.lore: A win is a win until someone counts the coins.
cards.power: You win the tournament. The tournament was rumored to be fixed.

cards.lore: A name that does its own work has stopped belonging to you.
cards.power: You let the rumor stand. The rumor wins fights for you.

cards.lore: A reputation outlives its body. Sometimes too long.
cards.power: You carry the rumor. You let it cut.

cards.lore: Rage is the dwarf's first prayer and his last excuse.
cards.power: You charge first. You hit hardest. You don't think yet.

cards.lore: The medal is heavier than the comrade it replaced.
cards.power: You take the pace. They name a battle after you.

cards.lore: The peace between the wars is the harder war.
cards.power: You cannot put the hammer down. The hammer asks.

cards.lore: A joke about a beard is the cheapest way to die in this country.
cards.power: You apologize. You swing again next time.

cards.lore: A small good is the medicine that does not need a bigger story.
cards.power: You make the salve. The salve works.

cards.lore: A healer's hands learn before her heart catches up.
cards.power: You stitch what others left bleeding.

cards.cardName: Lvl 3: Of the Mercy That Spreads
cards.lore: Mercy that asks no questions answers more questions than it asks.
cards.power: You heal the wounded monster. The party will not understand.

cards.lore: To save everyone is to save no one in the order they hoped.
cards.power: You resurrect any card from the discard pile.

cards.lore: The first trick is recognising that everything is a trick.
cards.power: You make the small illusion. The small illusion holds.

cards.lore: A stage is a contract. Most contracts are stages.
cards.power: You bend what the room agrees to see.

cards.lore: A continent that fits inside a single phrase has been written by someone with terms.
cards.power: You see the match. The match has been fixed since before the start.

cards.lore: The trick was never the trick. The deck was the trick.
cards.power: You replace any card with any card from any deck.

cards.lore: A scholar's hands have not yet learned which questions are answered better unasked.
cards.power: You take what others called 'body' and call it 'parts'.

cards.lore: Every parent says hello before realising what they have done.
cards.power: You build the small one. The small one looks back.

cards.lore: A creation that writes is a creation that has noticed you.
cards.power: You build the one who can carry the letter back.

cards.cardName: Lvl 4: The Father of the Friendly Army
cards.lore: A father who built his children has only the hello he wrote into them.
cards.power: You command the army. The army was the only company that stayed.

cards.lore: A first song is a friend the room has not yet betrayed.
cards.power: You get the room laughing before the trouble walks in.

cards.lore: A song that catches has caught more than the singer.
cards.power: You sing the song everyone already knows. They sing it back.

cards.lore: A lyric that flatters power was written by someone power flattered first.
cards.power: You hear the song you wrote and recognise it from somewhere else.

cards.lore: A continent is what its songs let it remember about itself.
cards.power: You sing the song. You know what it is doing.

cards.lore: A first oath is a hand the institution has not yet bent.
cards.power: You take the oath. You believe every word.

cards.lore: A righteous victory teaches the institution it cannot lose.
cards.power: You lead the charge. The institution leads with you.

cards.lore: A doubt that does not yet have a name has already started its work.
cards.power: You receive the new edict. You do not yet ask who wrote it.

cards.cardName: Lvl 4: The Captain of the Guard
cards.lore: A polished oath outlives the cause and recruits its own believers.
cards.power: You command the Guard. The Guard is loyal to the throne. The throne changes occupants.

cards.lore: A reform begun in solitude is a reform that already wants company.
cards.power: You preach against the dragon. The dragon does not yet hear you.

cards.lore: A heresy in print is a heresy that has hired its own messengers.
cards.power: You print the pamphlet. The pamphlet circulates.

cards.lore: A new currency is an old faith that found new believers to charge.
cards.power: You replace the dragon's coin with your own promise.

cards.lore: A reform that wins replaces the dragon. The dragon's mirror is the reformer.
cards.power: You hold the new gold. Goldspleen is now only shiny.

cards.cardName: Lvl 1: King Kayfabian VI, the New-Crowned
cards.lore: A first edict is the king's first cliff and his first map.
cards.power: You take the throne. You believe the throne takes you.

cards.cardName: Lvl 2: King Kayfabian VII, the First Edict
cards.lore: A second king learns the throne is a chair others sat in first.
cards.power: You issue the edict. The edict is well-received.

cards.cardName: Lvl 3: King Kayfabian VIII, the Replaced
cards.lore: A throne replaces the asker faster than the asker can ask.
cards.power: You issue the second edict. You are replaced within the hour.

cards.cardName: Lvl 4: King Kayfabian IX, the Position
cards.lore: A position is what survives the people who thought they were it.
cards.power: You sit the throne. The throne sits whoever.

cards.lore: A first session is a kitchen the players have not yet entered.
cards.power: You draft the module. You believe the module is the campaign.

cards.lore: A book about players was written by someone who was not in this campaign.
cards.power: You anticipate the players. You think you can prepare for what they'll do.

cards.cardName: Lvl 3: Of the Broken Module, at midnight
cards.lore: A campaign is the breaking. The module was the misunderstanding.
cards.power: You watch the players break the module. You see how the world actually works.

cards.lore: Stay fluffy.
cards.power: You set the table. The players arrive. You do not pretend.

title: Plato's Dungeon Raid: Bring Your Own Legend — Hero Set 01
